statement: Use one local source action S_src[psi_A,A_mu,g_eff,theta]=S_material+S_EM+S_int, varied with respect to the same effective metric/coframe that local gravity reads.
premise_or_note: This is the parent signature needed to stop EM/binding energy becoming a separate gravitational charge.

statement: For S_EM=-(1/4) int sqrt(-g_eff) Z_EM F_ab F^ab, the Hilbert stress is T_EM^{ab}=Z_EM(F^{a c}F^b_c - 1/4 g_eff^{ab} F_cd F^cd), up to metric-sign convention.
premise_or_note: This makes EM energy-momentum a source term of the same variational action, not an external force patch.

statement: On Maxwell equations, div T_EM^b = -F^b_c J^c while charged matter carries +F^b_c J^c, so div(T_material+T_EM+T_binding)^b equals only parent exchange q_exchange^b.
premise_or_note: The Lorentz force is internal exchange inside the same total source, not WEP-violating leakage.

statement: Composite-body inertial mass and active source charge must include EM binding energy through the same T_total, so composition dependence is not generated by bookkeeping.
premise_or_note: This is the WEP bridge from field stress to material source charge.

statement: If EM is emergent from MTS modes, its low-energy stress must descend to the same Hilbert/coframe T_EM above, with universal Z_EM and no species-labelled kappa_EM,A.
premise_or_note: This is the MTS-specific contract; without it, emergent EM is a residual channel.

statement: Same action + universal Z_EM + same total-source readout imply no EM-owned contribution to eta_source_AB, Gdot, or first PPN source mismatch except ordinary total stress already present in GR.
premise_or_note: This is a conditional local-GR-compatible EM stress theorem, not yet parent-signed.
